restricted.restriction: Pest control operations only by Govt./Govt. undertakings/Govt. organisations/pest control operators under strict supervision of Govt. experts or experts approved by the Plant Protection Adviser, except Aluminium Phosphide 15% 12 g tablet and Aluminium Phosphide 6% tablet. Tube packs of 10 and 20 tablets of 3 g each are banned completely (S.O. 677(E) dated 17.07.2001).

Foliar spray banned; to be used only as seed dresser (S.O. 569(E) dated 25.07.1989). Manufacture of Captafol 80% powder for dry seed treatment banned for use in the country except manufacture for export (S.O. 679(E) dated 17.07.2001).
All formulations except Carbofuran 3% encapsulated granule (CG) along with its crop labels may be stopped from use (S.O. 4294(E) dated 03.10.2023).
Banned for use in Ber, Citrus and Tobacco (S.O. 4294(E) dated 03.10.2023). Listed as "Chlorpyriphos".

Cypermethrin 3% Smoke Generator to be used only through pest control operators, not by the general public (Delhi High Court order in WP(C) 10052 of 2009 dated 14.07.2009 and LPA-429/2009 dated 08.09.2009).
Domestic public health use restricted to 10,000 MT per annum except in a major epidemic outbreak (S.O. 295(E) dated 08.03.2006). Use in agriculture withdrawn (S.O. 378(E) dated 26.05.1989).
Banned for use in fruits and vegetables that are consumed as raw food items (S.O. 4294(E) dated 03.10.2023).
Banned in agriculture except for locust control in scheduled desert area and public health (S.O. 706(E) dated 03.05.2007).
Banned for use on Sorghum, Pea, Soybean, Castor, Sunflower, Bhindi, Brinjal, Cauliflower, Radish, Turnip, Tomato, Apple, Mango and Grape (S.O. 4294(E) dated 03.10.2023).
Banned for use on Guava, Jowar and Tapioca (S.O. 4294(E) dated 03.10.2023).

Only by Govt./Govt. undertakings/Govt. organisations/pest control operators under strict supervision of Govt. experts or experts approved by the Plant Protection Adviser (G.S.R. 371(E) dated 20.05.1999).

Banned for use on vegetables (S.O. 1482(E) dated 10.10.2005). Monocrotophos 36% SL to be discontinued: no new registration certificates after S.O. 4294(E) dated 03.10.2023; after a one-year period all registrations of 36% SL stand cancelled, and sale, distribution or use is allowed only to clear existing stock until its expiry.
Banned for use on Potato and Groundnut (S.O. 4294(E) dated 03.10.2023).
Banned for use on Jute, Cardamom and Sorghum (S.O. 4294(E) dated 03.10.2023).
All uses except in wheat prohibited and completely banned from 08.08.2018; label must warn it is toxic to aquatic organisms (S.O. 3951(E) dated 08.08.2018).

draft_2020_27_pesticides.note: The 2020 draft Banning of Insecticides Order (S.O. 1512(E), May 2020) proposed banning 27 pesticides. The outcome for each is taken from the official 31.07.2026 CIB&RC list: the final order S.O. 4294(E) dated 03.10.2023 banned 3 (dicofol, dinocap, methomyl) and restricted 8. The list of 27 and the draft order number come from secondary sources (Wikipedia list of banned pesticides in India, ASHA Kisan Swaraj), so this block is marked uncertain; the outcomes themselves are from the official list.

app_notes: Monocrotophos 36% SL: registrations stand cancelled one year after 03.10.2023, so any 36% SL sold now is stock clearance at most. Flag it.
Carbofuran: only 3% CG remains permitted. Flag any other carbofuran formulation.
Phorate and triazophos are banned for use in India (manufacture for export only). Neither appears in the 31.03.2026 Major Uses lists.
Dichlorvos (DDVP) is banned (S.O. 3951(E) 2018) and listed again as export-only (S.O. 1196(E) 2020).
